definitions.usage: ((bed) inner) chamber, innermost(-ward) part, parlour, south, × within.
definitions.full: H2315. cheder חֶ֫דֶר noun masculine 1Chr 28:11 chamber, room (Late Hebrew id. ; Phoenician חדרת חדר, ; Sabean חֿדר Mordt ZMG, 1876, 24 ; Ethiopic ** is not 'chamber,' but (from √ dwell ) dwelling-place, abode, tent .) — absolute חֶדֶר 2Sam 13:10-11 t.; הַחַ֫דְרָה Gen 43:20 ; 1Kin 1:15 ; הֶחָ֑דְרָה Judg 15:1 ; 2Sam 13:10 ; construct חֶ֫דֶר Song 3:4 ; חֲדֶר Exodus 7:28 5 t.; suffix חֶדְרוֺ Joel 2:16 ; plural חֲדָרִים Deut 32:25 ; Prov 24:4 ; construct חַדְרֵי 7:27 8 t.; suffix חֲדָרֶיךָ Isa 26:20 ; חֲדָרָיו Song 1:4 ; 1Chr 28:11 ; — room, chamber , usually private, as bedroom Gen 43:30 (J), Judg 15:1 ; 16:9 , 12 ; 2Sam 13:10 (twice in verse); 1Kin 1:15 ; Song 1:4 ; Isa 26:20 ; Judg 14:18 read probably הַחַדְרָה bridal-chamber for הַחַרְסָה Sta ZAW 1884, 253 , compare Joel 2:16 (|| חֻמָּתָהּ of bride), ׳ח הוֺרָתִי Song 3:4 (|| אִמִּי בֵּית ); of kings (of Egypt) Psa 105:30 ; specifically: ׳ח מִשְׁכָּב bed-chamber Exodus 7:28 (J), 2Sam 4:7 ; 2Kin 6:12 ; Eccl 10:20 ; other combinations: — ׳ח הַמְּקֵרָה Judg 3:24 = cool chamber ; ׳ח הַמְּנִימִים 1Chr 28:11 inner chamber ; מַשְׂכִּיתוֺ חדרי Ezek 8:12 his chambers of imagery (strike out Hi Co Sgfrom); ׳ח ׳בְּח a chamber within a chamber , i.e. an innermost chamber 1Kin 20:30 ; 22:25 2Chr 18:24 ; 2Kin 9:2 ; plural = store-rooms Prov 24:4 ; so ׳ח הַמִּטּוֺת 2Kin 11:2 2Chr 22:11 , i.e. room where beds were stored (Ke Th); metaphor מָ֑וֶת ׳ח Prov 7:27 (|| שְׁאוֺל דַּרְכֵי ); תֵּמָן חדרי Job 9:9 chambers of south (where constellations are treasured up, see Di; Hoffm. thinks of proper name of star or constellation); compare 37:9 a chamber whence comes storm-wind ( סוּפָה ); בֶטֶן חַדְרֵי i.e. inner parts of body, only figurative Prov 18:8 = 26:22 ; 20:27 , 30 ; in Deut 32:25 מֵחֲדָרִים = within , poetic for מִבַּיִת , || מִחוּץ without.
